Kristi Leigh sits down with Dr Lee Merritt Navy-trained orthopedic spine surgeon and past president of the Association of American Physicians and Surgeons for a devastating exposé on the factory of fake science built by fake scientists Dr Merritt explains that the fraud goes far beyond medicine she has examined Darwin Einstein and the so-called father of vaccinology John Franklin Enders and found that the people could not have done what they claimed in the time allotted There is no proof of life no visible research no lectures no classes They hide behind academic walls She reveals that Enders Nobel Prize biography claims he served as an ensign in the Air Force during World War I but there was no Air Force and ensign is a naval rank When her son contacted the Nobel office they claimed it was probably a mistake from a book She says that doesnt work they verify biographies before publishing them
On Darwin Dr Merritt obtained the deck logs of the HMS Beagle from the British Admiralty and found that Darwin is not mentioned once The logs name everyone by name including an American seaman picked up and dropped off but not Charles Darwin He barely earned a degree in theology not biology or botany And he spent only 96 hours on the Galapagos Islands how do you determine finches changing over generations in 96 hours
